structs.name: AlgebraicError
structs.doc: 構文解析中に発生する可能性のあるエラーを定義します。

functions.name: try_new
functions.source_code: pub fn try_new (numer : i64 , denom : i64) -> Result < Self > { if denom == 0 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: DivisionByZero) ; } if numer == 0 { return Ok (Self { numer : 0 , denom : 1 , dirty : false , }) ; } let mut d = denom ; let mut n = numer ; if d < 0 { d = - d ; n = - n ; } let g = gcd_i64_u64 (n . abs () , d as u64) ; Ok (Self { numer : n / g as i64 , denom : (d as u64) / g , dirty : false , }) }

functions.name: normalize
functions.source_code: # [doc = " 完全正規化 (in-place)"] pub fn normalize (& mut self) { if ! self . dirty { return ; } if self . numer == 0 { self . denom = 1 ; self . dirty = false ; return ; } let g = gcd_i64_u64 (self . numer . abs () , self . denom) ; if g > 1 { self . numer /= g as i64 ; self . denom /= g ; } self . dirty = false ; }

functions.name: checked_add
functions.source_code: pub fn checked_add (self , rhs : Self) -> Result < Self > { if self . is_zero () { return Ok (rhs) ; } if rhs . is_zero () { return Ok (self) ; } let num1 = self . numer as i128 ; let den1 = self . denom as u128 ; let num2 = rhs . numer as i128 ; let den2 = rhs . denom as u128 ; let gcd = gcd_u64 (den1 as u64 , den2 as u64) as u128 ; let fact1 = den2 / gcd ; let fact2 = den1 / gcd ; let n128 = num1 * (fact1 as i128) + num2 * (fact2 as i128) ; if n128 == 0 { return Ok (Rational :: from_int (0)) ; } let denom_u128 = fact2 * den2 ; let (mut n_final , mut d_final) = if denom_u128 <= u64 :: MAX as u128 { (n128 , denom_u128 as u64) } else { let n_abs = n128 . unsigned_abs () ; let mut tmp_denom = denom_u128 ; let g2 = gcd_u128 (n_abs , tmp_denom) ; tmp_denom /= g2 ; if tmp_denom > u64 :: MAX as u128 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: RationalOverflow ("Add denominator overflow" . to_string () ,)) ; } let reduced_numer = n128 / (g2 as i128) ; if reduced_numer > i64 :: MAX as i128 || reduced_numer < i64 :: MIN as i128 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: RationalOverflow ("Add numerator overflow" . to_string () ,)) ; } return Ok (Rational { numer : reduced_numer as i64 , denom : tmp_denom as u64 , dirty : false , }) ; } ; let g2 = gcd_i128_u128 (n128 . unsigned_abs () , gcd) ; if g2 > 1 { n_final /= g2 as i128 ; d_final /= g2 as u64 ; } if n_final > i64 :: MAX as i128 || n_final < i64 :: MIN as i128 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: RationalOverflow ("Add numerator overflow" . to_string () ,)) ; } Ok (Rational { numer : n_final as i64 , denom : d_final , dirty : true , }) }

functions.name: checked_mul
functions.source_code: pub fn checked_mul (self , rhs : Self) -> Result < Self > { if self . is_zero () || rhs . is_zero () { return Ok (Rational { numer : 0 , denom : 1 , dirty : false , }) ; } let mut num1 = self . numer ; let mut den1 = self . denom ; let mut num2 = rhs . numer ; let mut den2 = rhs . denom ; let g1 = gcd_i64_u64 (num1 . abs () , den2) ; if g1 > 1 { num1 /= g1 as i64 ; den2 /= g1 ; } let g2 = gcd_i64_u64 (num2 . abs () , den1) ; if g2 > 1 { num2 /= g2 as i64 ; den1 /= g2 ; } let n128 = (num1 as i128) * (num2 as i128) ; let denom_u128 = (den1 as u128) * (den2 as u128) ; if denom_u128 > u64 :: MAX as u128 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: RationalOverflow ("Mul denominator overflow" . to_string () ,)) ; } if n128 > i64 :: MAX as i128 || n128 < i64 :: MIN as i128 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: RationalOverflow ("Mul numerator overflow" . to_string () ,)) ; } Ok (Rational { numer : n128 as i64 , denom : denom_u128 as u64 , dirty : self . dirty || rhs . dirty , }) }

functions.name: checked_div
functions.source_code: pub fn checked_div (self , rhs : Self) -> Result < Self > { if rhs . is_zero () { return Err (AlgebraicError :: DivisionByZero) ; } if rhs . denom > i64 :: MAX as u64 { return Err (AlgebraicError :: RationalOverflow ("Reciprocal numerator overflow" . to_string () ,)) ; } let flipped = Rational { numer : rhs . denom as i64 * rhs . numer . signum () , denom : rhs . numer . unsigned_abs () , dirty : rhs . dirty , } ; self . checked_mul (flipped) }
